sections.appearance: She has bright orange, messy bob cut hair with bangs and a braid styled on her left. She has bright red eyes and black glasses. Halo ==== Kotori's halo is an orange triangle surrounded by a larger triangle and three angled arrows, each corresponding to the larger triangle's edges. There are also three hexagonal shapes in each of the smaller triangle's angles. Uniform ==== She wears a standard uniform consisting of a navy blue furry winter coat, her white shirt, a loose blue tie underneath, and an unbuttoned pleated, black skirt tied to straps, alongside a pair of white socks and black sneakers with blue shoelaces. Gym: She wore a light blue uniform jacket, a dark blue T-shirt underneath, and shorts with two white stripes on the sides. Her shoes were the same as the original. Firearm ==== thumb|Professor K|150px She utilizes a white Dillon Aero M134 "Minigun" with grey barrels. A "chainsaw grip" is attached to the weapon for hip fire portability. The Millenium logo is imprinted on the feeder-delinker.

sections.personality: Nicknamed as the "Walking Encyclopedia." Whenever there's a problem or if someone asks a question, Kotori would go as far back as its history and explain every single detail, and she became more excited the more detail she explained. Due to this, people often tend to avoid talking to her, just so they don't have to hear her lectures. Her dream is become a professor that giving lectures in a hall full of people wanting to learn. On the other hand, when Sensei asked her to describe her hobbies and favorite things, she gets hesitant and flustered, as seen in her relationship story.
